{{Quote|Eat at Aruk|Advertisement on Nar Shaddaa|<ref name="Republic 54">[[Republic 54|''Republic'' 54]]</ref>}}
'''Aruk's Cantina''' was a legitimate bar located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Although [[Aruk Besadii Aora|Aruk]] resided on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] he often attended to business here and was fiercely loyal to his regular customers and clients.

Advertisements in the form of colorful [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] neon signs, were put up in the local area, in order to attract potential customers.

==History==
At one time [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] got into a fight with several of the patrons just before Aruk and his entourage were coming in. Aruk was furious that Kolar was causing trouble in his [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] again as he had several times before and forced him to leave.
